The '''marlello''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Duck/Legends|duck]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lowick/Legends|Lowick]]. Its large [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] were part of the [[Pa'lowick/Legends|Pa'lowick]] [[Diet/Legends|diet]], whose long snouts were perfectly adapted to eating [[marlello duck egg]]s, which they punctured with their tongues to suck the yolk through their tube-like mouths.<ref name="EGTAS" />
